newsitem.title: USA: Health Systems to invest in NJ health plan.
newsitem.headline: Health Systems to invest in NJ health plan.

text.p: Health Systems International Inc said on Friday it would make a $30 million investment in FOHP Inc, the parent of First Option Health Plan (FOHP) of Red Bank, New Jersey.
At the closing of the deal, expected by the end of 1996, Health Systems will buy $30 million of FOHP subordinated debentures convertible into a 40 percent stake of FOHP.
FOHP will issue an option to Health Systems that could eventually allow it to add 11 percent more to its stake, Health Systems said.
The agreement provides the further option allowing up to another 20 percent of FOHP equity to be purchased by Health Systems or repurchased by FOHP.

In addition, Health Systems will provide a variety of management services to FOHP, a managed health care company owned by physicians, hospitals and other health-care providers in New Jersey. FOHP's network includes 51 hospitals and more than 10,000 member physicians.
FOHP recorded 1995 revenues of $111.4 million, Health Systems said.
